verdict.credibility_line: Capex and balance-sheet statements check out, but revenue and margin promises have slipped sharply.

promises.promise: Expect sequential revenue growth in Mar 2026 over Sep 2025.
promises.delivered: Mar 2026 revenue fell 16% sequentially to 1,565 crore versus 1,872 crore in Sep 2025.

promises.promise: Maintain 22% EBITDA margin in FY27, consistent with the referenced quarter.
promises.delivered: Sep 2026 quarter EBITDA margin was 13.7%, far below the 22% target quoted for FY27.

promises.promise: Deliver positive revenue growth in FY27.
promises.delivered: FY26 full year has not ended yet; only FY27 quarterly results are available so far.

promises.promise: Grow pharma top-line to 500–600 crore within 2–3 years.
promises.delivered: Pharma and electronic-chemicals revenue is not split out in the numbers provided; consolidated data cannot verify it.

bull: May 2026 call projected FY26 capex of 700–800 crore; actual FY26 investing cash flow was 612 crore, within tolerance.
Nov 2026 call projected 49% gross margin in near term; no gross-margin numbers are provided, so this remains unverifiable.
May 2026 call cited a debt-free balance sheet; latest debt/equity of 0.03 supports a debt-free profile.
bear: Aug 2026 call promised FY27 EBITDA margin of 22%; Sep 2026 quarter EBITDA margin was only 13.7%.
Feb 2026 call promised Mar 2026 sequential revenue growth; Mar 2026 revenue fell to 1,565 crore from 1,872 crore.
May 2026 call claimed resilient 25% FY26 EBITDA margin; actual FY26 EBITDA margin was 25.8%, below target.
questions: Did the Aug 2026 gross-margin target hold up after input-cost pressure continued?
Is FY27 EBITDA margin still defensible if the Sep 2026 quarter remains near 14%?
Can pharma unit economics improve enough to validate the 500–600 crore target?
